info.name: Community Networking and Events Discovery Platform (Nearby)
info.description: Complete API collection for the Nearby Spring Boot backend. Every request sends JSON and every response is JSON. Run 'Login' first (or 'Register') — its test script auto-saves the JWT into the {{token}} collection variable, which the collection-level Bearer auth then applies to every other request automatically.
